text:
The plate is a square dinner plate, about 26 cm across. It holds a modest mound of brown rice with a few carrot bits, roughly 10 × 12 cm and fairly thin. I estimate about 130 g of cooked rice. Cooked brown rice runs about 1.2–1.5 kcal/g, and a little oil may have been used, which puts the total near 190 kcal.
